name: usa-diving-staff-apps
description: Internal staff web applications for USA Diving. This package.json exists only to pin the dependency the regression-guard test scripts need (membership-analytics/test-*.js) -- there is no build step and no runtime dependency for the apps themselves, which are vanilla JS with no bundler.

scripts.test: cd membership-analytics && node test-billing.js && node test-studio.js && node test-route-step.js
